raw_layer.grain: rows are financial items; reporting periods are columns

processed_layer.grain: one row per ticker and reporting period
processed_layer.shape: wide columns of standardized amounts and derived ratios

transformation_contract: bctc_processor.py maps raw item/item_en to standardized item_id.
Raw period columns are unpivoted/normalized into ticker-period rows.
Provider percentage scale differences must be normalized before comparison.
Some output values are coalesced by industry or calculated proxies; they are not direct reported facts.
Never join raw and processed data assuming identical grain.
